title: Refined Saw
body:
"Flawlessly removes bark off logs, NOTE: LOGS MAY HAVE TO BE CUT UP."

Description

Refined Saw is a saw sold at The Oak Depot for $5,000. It's the second best saw a player can buy, below the Reinforced Saw.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price. Essentially, Refined Saw is a worse handheld version of Industrial Sander. Despite this, it can be useful on branches to avoid making bits and pieces of wood.

Appearance

Refined Saw, like the name implies, is a typical saw that seems to be made out of refined steel and wood. It's blade is made out of refined steel; using the default legacy metal material as it's coating. It's handle is made out of wood, painted blue; using the default legacy sand material as it's coating.

Trivia

  • Refined Saw was added into the game much later than the other tools.
